description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing device registrations in the Fineract platform, including endpoints to register, retrieve, update, and delete device registration data.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for device registration management, handling CRUD operations via HTTP endpoints.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Handles the registration of a new device, parses JSON request body, and returns the device ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllDeviceRegistrations
methods.description: Retrieves all device registration records as JSON.

methods.name: retrieveDeviceRegistrationByClientId
methods.description: Retrieves a device registration record associated with a specific client ID.

methods.name: retrieveDeviceRegiistration
methods.description: Retrieves a device registration record by its unique ID.

methods.name: updateDeviceRegistration
methods.description: Updates an existing device registration with new data from JSON input.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a device registration record by its ID.

methods.name: responseMap
methods.description: Generates a JSON string with the resource ID for confirmation responses.
